blocks.text:
# Release notes

> [!NOTE]
> Quotas reset at **midnight UTC**, see https://example.com/quotas.

> [!TIP]
> Press `s` to see the diff side by side.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The API counts each export against the organisation.

> [!WARNING]
> A plan change takes effect the next day.

> [!CAUTION]
> Deleting an organisation drops its history.

Footnotes work too[^quota], and so does a second one[^2].

- [x] ~~old quota~~ removed
- [ ] www.example.org autolinked

[^quota]: Counted per organisation, not per teammate.
[^2]: Second note with `code`.
